status_definitions.implemented: The edge is reproduced by committed fixtures and a deterministic product command in this case.
status_definitions.documented: The products document the boundary, but this case does not execute or retain that handoff.
status_definitions.demonstration-only: The case authors an explicit, digest-bound bridge because no runtime producer-consumer adapter is implemented.

edges.boundary: Signal to Insight implements export and validation of the research packet. Enterprise Architecture Composer has no consumer adapter for it. The sidecar records a manually authored synthetic translation, requires human review, and grants no approval or execution authority.

edges.verification_command: node "$EAC_REPO/bin/eac.mjs" visual "$CASE_DIR/fixtures/architecture-context.json" --markdown --output /tmp/architecture.visual.md && node "$VW_REPO/dist/cli.js" validate /tmp/architecture.visual.md && node "$VW_REPO/dist/cli.js" render /tmp/architecture.visual.md --view executive --output /tmp/architecture.executive.svg && python3 "$CASE_DIR/normalize_render.py" /tmp/architecture.executive.svg
edges.boundary: Composer owns the architecture proposal, IDs, and synthetic decision record. Visual Workbench owns validation, layout, and rendering. The SVG is a presentation artifact and neither approves nor changes the architecture decision.

No Visual Workbench-to-Project Evidence Graph importer exists. The case binds the SVG digest into a manually authored synthetic graph. The implemented product adapter runs in the opposite direction: Project Evidence Graph to Visual Workbench.
Project Evidence Graph proves structural validity and traceability coverage for this synthetic graph. It does not prove architecture fitness, implementation, production readiness, or human approval.

edges.verification_command: Follow the verified external-evidence registry workflow documented by Cutover Graph; this reference case retains no reconciliation run or registry.
edges.boundary: Optional and excluded from this pack. A syntactically valid reconciliation reference is not positive evidence without a verified local evidence-document binding.

edges.verification_command: Follow the import-cutover workflow documented by Cutover Graph and Project Evidence Graph; this reference case retains no cutover artifact index.
edges.boundary: Optional and excluded from this pack. An unverified external checkpoint must remain an assurance gap rather than being promoted to positive evidence.

boundaries.eac_identity_effect: Identity only. Each case-owned eac:// reference identifies a detached reference-case artifact; it is not a network location, signature, authorization, or trust assertion.
boundaries.runtime_claim: Only Composer-to-Visual Workbench and local Project Evidence structural analysis are executed by this pack. The other connections retain their declared demonstration or documentation status.
